verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Fastmail only as a hosted service: per-account sessions at api.fastmail.com and data residency in Fastmail-run regions. Nothing shows a self-hostable Fastmail app or user-controlled mail pipeline. JMAP being an open standard with third-party server implementations is a protocol building block, not Fastmail's own self-hosting capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
